title: Completion after fixing a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be one of those coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If coordinate $i$ is free in $\rho$, then completing $x$ after fixing coordinate $i$ to the sign encoded by $x_i$ gives the same sign vector as completing $x$ using $\rho$.
